content: Firestore Security Rules reference the fact that reads are document-level: 'Reads in Rules are performed at the document level. You either retrieve the full document, or you retrieve nothing. There is no way to retrieve a partial document. It is impossible using security rules alone to prevent users from reading specific fields within a document.' Writes CAN be field-restricted via request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly()/hasAny() and diff().affectedKeys(). Practical mitigation documented in the community: split public and sensitive data into separate top-level collections keyed by the SAME document id (e.g. users/{uid} and privateProfiles/{uid}) so each gets its own rule.
